name: Arcadia
source: At the game start, player can choose from 5 different names. Depending on the name chosen, character will have different set of starting attributes (intelligence, charisma, morality, etc). Certain level of a particular attribute unlocks corresponding "training" route.
translation: At the game start, player can choose from 5 different names. Depending on the name chosen, character will have different set of starting attributes (intelligence, charisma, morality, etc). Certain level of a particular attribute unlocks corresponding "training" route.
